description: Local calendar-day summaries from PostgreSQL. At most 31 days, max gap 60–86400 seconds. Means use actual samples; estimated durations exclude long gaps and unknown readings. Comparison includes partial days.

panels.description: Sample means are not time-weighted. Durations are estimates with bounded holding time; unknown intervals are excluded. Partial days are compared as observed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT value->>'date' AS "Day", concat(value->>'home_name', ' / ', value->>'zone_name', ' [', value->>'home_id', '/', value->>'zone_id', ']') AS "Room", (value#>>'{temperature_c,min}')::double precision AS "Min °C", (value#>>'{temperature_c,mean}')::double precision AS "Mean °C", (value#>>'{temperature_c,max}')::double precision AS "Max °C", (value->>'temperature_mean_change_c')::double precision AS "Change vs previous day °C", (value#>>'{temperature_c,samples}')::bigint AS "Samples" FROM tado_bridge_daily_summary($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), ${summary_timezone:sqlstring}, (${summary_max_gap:sqlstring})::double precision, ${summary_home:sqlstring}, ${summary_room:sqlstring}) AS s(value)

panels.title: Daily temperature — samples and comparison

panels.description: Sample means are not time-weighted. Durations are estimates with bounded holding time; unknown intervals are excluded. Partial days are compared as observed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT value->>'date' AS "Day", concat(value->>'home_name', ' / ', value->>'zone_name', ' [', value->>'home_id', '/', value->>'zone_id', ']') AS "Room", CASE WHEN (value->>'target_coverage_seconds')::double precision > 0 THEN (value->>'below_target_seconds')::double precision / 3600 END AS "Below target h", (value->>'target_coverage_seconds')::double precision / 3600 AS "Target coverage h", (value->>'heating_active_seconds')::double precision / 3600 AS "Heating active h", (value->>'heating_coverage_seconds')::double precision / 3600 AS "Heating coverage h", (value#>>'{target_temperature_c,mean}')::double precision AS "Mean target °C" FROM tado_bridge_daily_summary($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), ${summary_timezone:sqlstring}, (${summary_max_gap:sqlstring})::double precision, ${summary_home:sqlstring}, ${summary_room:sqlstring}) AS s(value)

panels.title: Estimated activity — coverage matters

panels.description: Sample means are not time-weighted. Durations are estimates with bounded holding time; unknown intervals are excluded. Partial days are compared as observed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT greatest((value->>'day_start')::timestamptz, $__timeFrom()) AS time, concat(value->>'home_name', ' / ', value->>'zone_name', ' [', value->>'home_id', '/', value->>'zone_id', ']') AS metric, (value#>>'{temperature_c,mean}')::double precision AS value FROM tado_bridge_daily_summary($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), ${summary_timezone:sqlstring}, (${summary_max_gap:sqlstring})::double precision, ${summary_home:sqlstring}, ${summary_room:sqlstring}) AS s(value)

list.label: Home
list.name: summary_home
list.query: SELECT 'All homes' AS __text, '' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT concat(h->>'name', ' [', h->>'id', ']'), h->>'id' FROM tado_bridge_snapshots s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.payload->'homes') h WHERE $__timeFilter(s.collected_at)

list.description: Select a home first to discover its rooms.
list.label: Room
list.name: summary_room
list.query: SELECT 'All rooms' AS __text, '' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT concat(z->>'name', ' [', z->>'id', ']'), z->>'id' FROM tado_bridge_snapshots s CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s.payload->'homes') h CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(h->'zones') z WHERE $__timeFilter(s.collected_at) AND h->>'id' = ${summary_home:sqlstring} AND ${summary_home:sqlstring} <> ''
